required.what: VDDA18AON and VDD present before any other supply (except VBAT), kept present while any other is, and ramp up/down together within 1 ms — damage otherwise
VDDA18USB must be present whenever VDD33USB is present; VDDCORE present whenever VDDA18USB/VDD33USB are
Supply slew 20–1500 µs/V (VDDA18AON, VDD/VDDIOx, VDDCORE rise), 10–1500 µs/V for the others
V08CAP: decoupling capacitor only, never used externally
VDDA18PLLx connected together; VDDCORE/CSI/DSI/LVDS/COMBOPHY/PCIECLK usually together
All power and ground pins connected to a supply in range; |ΔVDDx| within a domain ≤ 50 mV; |VSSx−VSS| ≤ 50 mV
Injected current: ΣIINJ ≤ ±25 mA; IIO ≤ 20 mA per pin (−40…90 °C TJ)
BOOT0–3 (TTPD), DDR_*, DSI_*, LVDS_*, PCIE_* pins not in Table 9 / Table 14 VIN rows — not covered here; DDR I/O VIN ≤ VDDQDDR (operating)
